title: P2-14c batched-atomicity-bench: A/B benchmark on `submit + 100 actions`; flip batched_atomicity default after ≥3× throughput
description: Feature P2-14c (split from black-hat-revised vb-8fbja). Black-hat review round 1 split the original P2-14 into 3 sub-beads; this is the third. This bead (P2-14c) handles sub-phase (14c) only: feature-flag batched_atomicity = false (default), A/B benchmark on `submit + 100 actions` workload, and flip the default to true after the benchmark shows ≥3× throughput. Depends on P2-14a (the storage batch) and P2-14b (the coalescing layer). Real source: crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/config.rs (ShardConfig — this bead adds batched_atomicity: bool to ShardConfig v2, from P0-COORD), crates/vb_benchmark/benches/ (the benchmark suite — we add a new bench target). The new logic: (1) add `batched_atomicity: bool` to ShardConfig v2 (default false); (2) when false, Shard::tick commits each command individually (no coalescing); (3) when true, the P2-14b coalescing layer is enabled; (4) run the A/B benchmark on `submit + 100 actions`; (5) record the throughput ratio in `.evidence/batched_atomicity_bench.json`; (6) if the ratio is ≥3×, flip the default to true (this is a one-line change to ShardConfig::default()). Master §61: the ≥3× threshold is the acceptance bar. Kani harness: prove batched_atomicity=true is functionally equivalent to batched_atomicity=false modulo throughput. proptest: 100 random workflows assert functional equivalence.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL expose batched_atomicity: bool in ShardConfig (default false)
THE SYSTEM SHALL flip the default to true after the A/B benchmark shows ≥3× throughput on `submit + 100 actions`

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the A/B benchmark on `submit + 100 actions` records a throughput ratio ≥3×
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL set ShardConfig::default().batched_atomicity = true (a one-line change in the default impl)

unwanted.condition: IF the A/B benchmark ratio is <3×
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT flip the default; it must remain false and the benchmark result must be reported
unwanted.because: Master §61: the ≥3× threshold is the acceptance bar; flipping below the threshold would violate the contract
